_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for standalone decorative architectural elements (beams, columns, mantels). Combined prime+paint, full phase scope. Context prefix ARCH is unique — no collision with existing TSK_ prefixes.

paintable_items.name: Decorative beam
paintable_items.notes: Running LF of exposed beam length. Profile complexity (width, face count, detail) handled by beam_profile modifier. Typically 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides) for ceiling-mounted beams.

paintable_items.name: Decorative column wrap
paintable_items.notes: Each column counted individually. Size and profile complexity handled by column_type modifier. Height via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND.

paintable_items.name: Fireplace mantel/surround
paintable_items.notes: Each mantel counted individually. Assembly complexity handled by mantel_type modifier. Typically wall height H1.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: TSK_FRAME_, TSK_DOOR_, TSK_CEIL_, TSK_WALL_, TSK_TRIM_, TSK_WIN_, TSK_STRS_, TSK_WNSC_, TSK_WDWL_, TSK_WDCL_. ARCH is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_ARCH_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (e.g., TSK_ARCH_SAND_PREP, TSK_ARCH_FINISH_SPRAY, TSK_ARCH_CAULK_BEAM)

paintscope_keys.description: Running LF of standalone decorative beams
paintscope_keys.notes: New key. No existing key covers standalone beam surfaces.
New key. No existing key covers column counting.
New key. No existing key covers mantel counting.

paintscope_keys.description: Localized floor protection around spray work area
Ceiling fixtures near beam spray work
Height modifier for beams/columns at elevation
Wall masking LF near spray target (beam-wall, column-wall, mantel-wall junctions)

quality_tier.notes: QT2 prohibited — prominent millwork per Millwork Doctrine SS6.

application_method.notes: No roll — these are millwork. Spray preferred for production speed. Brush for occupied spaces, small scope, or intricate profiles.

sheen.notes: Per QT gate: satin (QT3+), semi-gloss (QT4+), gloss (QT5 only). Single values only.

phase.notes: Combined prime+paint spec uses setup through cleanup. 'apply' omitted — spec uses prime and finish directly.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for brush floor_perimeter. full_cover for spray floor_workzone and fixture_covers. partial_cover for wall_adjacent spray masking.

surface_ids.notes: beam_wrap, column_wrap, and mantel exist in Surface_Vocabulary_Reference.md but are not yet in id_registry active use. ceiling_field and wall_field are existing active entries. Three primary surfaces because this spec has 3 paintable items with distinct surface types.

existing_systems_to_reuse.notes: Standard acrylic trim enamel. Reuse — already used in 7 other millwork specs.
Modified urethane trim enamel. Reuse — already used in 7 other millwork specs.
Premium urethane trim enamel. Reuse — already used in 7 other millwork specs.
Acrylic wood primer for bare softwood. Reuse.
Solvent-based MDF edge sealer. Step 1 of two-step MDF prime. Reuse.
High-build latex face primer for MDF. Step 2 of two-step MDF prime. Reuse.
Stain-blocking primer for poplar. MANDATORY for bare poplar. Reuse.
Tannin-blocking primer for hardwood (oak, cherry, walnut). Reuse.

material_system_prefix.notes: All 8 SYS_ IDs are existing. No new material systems needed. REUSE OVER CREATION.

consumable_prefix.notes: All consumables expected for this spec have existing CON_ IDs. No new consumable IDs anticipated.

proposed_for_this_spec.description: Bare substrate: primer + 2 finish coats. Standard for SS_BARE at QT3/QT4.
Factory-primed: 2 finish coats. Standard for SS_PRIMED_FACTORY at QT3/QT4.
QT5 brush: 3 finish coats per FFD SS15.10.3. Only at QT5 + brush method.
Coverage rate for primer on architectural element surfaces
Coverage rate for finish coat on architectural element surfaces

cross_spec_coordination.notes: COMP_FIREPLACE (1.30x) from Modifier_Registry affects wall/ceiling painting in rooms with fireplaces. This spec IS the architectural element work — not affected by the modifier itself, but mantels are the source of COMP_FIREPLACE complexity for adjacent wall/ceiling specs.

sop_modules_json.phase_ordering: setup → prep → prime → interstage → finish → cleanup

production_json.task_id_threading: Every TSK_ in production.json MUST exactly match sop_modules.json

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ context prefix ARCH established here — all downstream TSK_ IDs use TSK_ARCH_
RULE 10: ITM_ IDs ITM_ARCH_BEAM, ITM_ARCH_COLUMN, ITM_ARCH_MANTEL — use exactly as written
RULE 11: Downstream agents use ONLY enum values from this file's applicable_enums — never pull from raw registries
